text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after finishing the run... what was 
she running for? The purpose remained 
completely unclear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What kind of dreams do other Umamusume 
have? To use it as reference, she decided 
to head to the Japan Cup, the world's 
showcase of dreams.
